title: Elevated employee work areas.
officialText: Where the elevation is critical to the proper work operations, work areas or portions of work areas, other than raised courtroom stations, that are less than 300 square feet (30 m2) in area and elevated 7 inches (178 mm) or more above the ground or finish floor shall be exempt from all requirements.
